The '''R-Family Torso Shell''' was a barrel-shaped [[Droid/Legends|droid]] torso produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. Although it looked like the [[R-Family Locomotion Unit|locomotion unit]] of the [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], it was made to be assembled with droid [[Limb/Legends|legs]] and arms on a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-looking body.
